notes.title: 1.3.2 - Released
notes.content:
•New quick select feature added to the scenario selection menu. Select new eye icon above scenario art to access quick select.
•Sorting features added to scenario selection. Sort by release, name, difficulty and duration via the quick select feature. 
•All scenario content now showcased in the scenario selection menu. Products not enabled in the Collection manager will display their associated scenarios as locked content. Enable physical products in Collection menu to unlock their associated scenarios. 
•Restore purchases dialog added to scenario selection menu.
•Visual update to the Collection Manager. 
•Added Italian & Polish language content to Recurring Nightmares & Suppressed Memories products. 
•Added Polish language content to Beyond the Threshold product. 
•German content for non-core scenarios has been disabled to allow for additional text editing. Localized scenario descriptions will remain active.
•Minor bug fixes and text updates

notes.title: 1.3.0 - Released
notes.content:
Beyond the Threshold, a new physical expansion for Mansions of Madness second edition, is now available!
Introduces new ways of experiencing the game, a new threatening monster to face, new investigators, and new
Mythos events! Add Beyond the Threshold to your digital Collection to access this new, terrifying content! 

Version 1.3 adds the following
•Beyond the Threshold product added to the Collection manager
•Vengeful Impulses scenario (requires Beyond the Threshold)
•Gates of Silverwood Manor (requires Beyond the Threshold)
•Fixes minor bugs in What Lies Within DLC
•Minor bug and typo fixes in all scenarios.
